    if item.get('account_name')=='spotify':
        spotify_password=item.get('password')
        break
print('spotify_password_found', bool(spotify_password))
print('spotify_password_len', len(spotify_password) if spotify_password is not None else None)
spotify_token_resp=apis.spotify.login(username=spotify_user, password=spotify_password)

recs=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp=apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=spotify_access_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
    # resp expected list
    print('page',page_index,'len',len(resp))
    if not resp:
        break
    recs.extend(resp)
    page_index+=1
print('total_recommendations',len(recs))
print('first5_song_ids',[r.get('song_id') for r in recs[:5]])

arguments.code:
# Build song_id list from previously fetched recommendations
song_ids=[r['song_id'] for r in recs]
print('recommended_song_count',len(song_ids))
print('recommended_song_ids',song_ids)

# 1) Clear current queue
clear_resp=apis.spotify.clear_song_queue(access_token=spotify_access_token)
print('clear_resp',clear_resp)

# 2) Add all recommended songs to queue
add_responses=[]
for i,sid in enumerate(song_ids):
    resp=apis.spotify.add_to_queue(access_token=spotify_access_token,song_id=sid)
    add_responses.append(resp)
    if i<5 or i==len(song_ids)-1:
        print('added',i+1,'of',len(song_ids),'song_id',sid,'resp',resp)
print('add_calls',len(add_responses))

# 3) Shuffle queue
shuffle_resp=apis.spotify.shuffle_song_queue(access_token=spotify_access_token)
print('shuffle_resp',shuffle_resp)

# 4) Play current queue
play_resp=apis.spotify.play_music(access_token=spotify_access_token)
print('play_resp',play_resp)

# Verification: check queue state once
queue=apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=spotify_access_token)
print('queue_returned_len',len(queue))
current=[q for q in queue if q.get('is_current')]
playing=[q for q in queue if q.get('is_playing')]
print('current_count',len(current))
print('playing_count',len(playing))
print('current_song',current[0] if current else None)
print('first3_queue_positions',[{k:q[k] for k in ['position','song_id','title','is_current','is_playing']} for q in queue[:3]])
# Also verify that all recommended song_ids exist in queue multiset-ish
queue_song_ids=[q.get('song_id') for q in queue]
missing=[sid for sid in song_ids if sid not in set(queue_song_ids)]
print('missing_recommended',missing)
